prompt.zh-TW: 下列哪些事情會出現在風行腳踏車行的現金流量表上？
prompt.en: Which of the following would appear on Breeze Bicycles’ statement of cash flows?

text.zh-TW: 客人付現買走一台公路車
text.en: A customer pays cash for a road bike

feedback.zh-TW: 會出現。收到現金，屬於營業活動。
feedback.en: It appears. Cash was received, under operating activities.

text.zh-TW: 車行用現金還清一筆銀行借款
text.en: The shop repays a bank loan in cash

feedback.zh-TW: 會出現。付出現金，屬於籌資活動。
feedback.en: It appears. Cash was paid out, under financing activities.

text.zh-TW: 客人賒帳買走一台公路車，月底才付款
text.en: A customer takes a road bike on credit and will pay at month end

feedback.zh-TW: 這個月不會出現。收入已經賺到，但一毛現金都還沒進來；等收款時才會出現。
feedback.en: Not this month. The revenue has been earned, but no cash has arrived yet; it appears only when the customer pays.

text.zh-TW: 阿凱估計倉庫裡的舊車架今年少值了一些錢
text.en: Kai estimates that the old frames in the warehouse are worth a little less this year

feedback.zh-TW: 不會出現。這只是帳面金額的調整，沒有任何現金進出。
feedback.en: It does not appear. This only adjusts a carrying amount; no cash moves.

explanation.zh-TW: 現金流量表只記真的收到或付出的錢。{{option:o_ap76}}收到現金、{{option:o_h13r}}付出現金，都會出現；{{option:o_26d5}}還沒收款，{{option:o_z21y}}沒有現金進出，都不會出現。
explanation.en: The statement of cash flows records only cash actually received or paid. {{option:o_ap76}} receives cash and {{option:o_h13r}} pays cash, so both appear; {{option:o_26d5}} has not been collected yet and {{option:o_z21y}} moves no cash, so neither appears.
